description: Search retained county-roll address candidates for partial queries and typos. If the intended property is ambiguous, show the relevant candidates and ask the user to select one before continuing with property-specific conclusions or actions. Similarity scores and is_auto_match are matching hints, not a user selection, verified owner authority or financial eligibility.

limit.description: Maximum number of candidate suggestions to return (default: 5)

query.description: Address query or partial street name (e.g. '3731 Andrson Ave', 'Anderson Ave', '810 Lindsay')

name: suggest_addresses
